## Introduction

In this course we covered Bubble, Optimized Bubble, Selection and Insertion sort. This page includes practice problems to help you prepare for your exam and internalize each sorting algorithm: trace them, count comparisons and swaps, and write the code.

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer and an explanation. Problems that ask you to write Python run your code in the browser; the first run downloads the Python runtime (about 10 MB).

[Review the lesson](../../lessons/04%20Searching%20and%20Sorting/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
